description: Tier-1 library manifest. The orchestrator reads this at Stage 1 to enumerate available reference libraries beyond the canonical reference/ corpus. Funds drop fund-agnostic or fund-specific templates and disclosure libraries into the subdirectories below.

tier_1_templates.description: Statement and note templates used by Mechanical (L4 template compliance) for caption / ordering checks. Apollo controllership maintains a default ASC 946 LP template; fund-specific overrides land beside it with the fund-code suffix.

tier_1_note_libraries.description: Disclosure libraries used by Narrative (L3 disclosure completeness) for inventory of expected disclosures per topic. Apollo controllership maintains a default disclosure library; fund-specific additions are merged at read time.

policy_memos_directory.description: Per-fund policy memos (LPA, VPM, expense allocation memo, side-letter equivalent treatment). NOT part of _LIBRARY because they are fund-specific. Subagents read from the manifest's policy_memos array.
